Comment: IRIS RWE pipeline. A completion marker in raw/ triggers preflight -> validate/transform -> QC gate -> cohort + analysis -> notify. The execution input is only a bucket and a key; everything else is derived inside the pipeline so EventBridge can start it without a human.

Retry.Comment: Transient service errors retry. A QC gate breach raises SystemExit inside the job and is deliberately not retried - rerunning the same data produces the same result.

Catch.Comment: Infrastructure and code errors are an engineering problem. Only a genuine QC breach should page a scientist.

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline succeeded
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} completed. Triggered by s3://{}/{}. Results: s3://{}/results/{}/', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $.key, $.bucket, $$.Execution.Name)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline halted: preflight
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} halted at preflight. s3://{}/{} did not match the expected schema. Engineering issue - check whether a site changed its export format.', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $.key)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline halted: data quality gate
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} halted at the QC gate. The curated layer was NOT written and no cohort was built. See s3://{}/metadata/{}/validation_report.json. A clinical plausibility failure needs a scientist, not an engineer.', $$.Execution.Name, $.bucket, $$.Execution.Name)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline failed: job error
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} failed inside the validate/transform job for an infrastructure or code reason, not a data quality gate. Check the Glue job logs.', $$.Execution.Name)

Parameters.Subject: IRIS RWE pipeline failed: cohort or analysis
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Run {} failed during cohort construction or analysis. Curated data is intact; the failure is downstream of it.', $$.Execution.Name)

Halted.Cause: The pipeline stopped before producing results. See the SNS notification and the validation report for which gate failed.
